verdict.rationale: The evidence documents only card creation via API (POST /cards for virtual or physical cards). Nothing in the pack covers activating, pausing or unpausing, reporting lost or stolen, reissuing with a linked replacement, or permanently closing cards. Card-level auth rules and spend limits are adjacent controls, not lifecycle state transitions, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, the full card lifecycle is API-driven — activate, pause, unpause, report lost or stolen, reissue with a replacement linked to the original, and permanently close
